purpose: Operational recruitment/pipeline tracker for Product Validation-1 moderated ICP sessions. One entry per real person, anonymized reference id only. Target: 6-8 completed sessions.

targets.rationale: Cold executive outreach converts low; plan roughly 3x sourced vs completed target so one channel underperforming does not stall the gate.
mix_requirements: >=4 participants with a senior-level transition in the last 3 years
>=3 participants with recruiter or executive-search-consultant interaction
mix of currently employed and actively searching participants
do not recruit only highly technical AI enthusiasts
targets.review_cadence: Check funnel weekly; if sourced < 12 after week one, widen channels before screening further.
